voice.name: 阿刁
voice.rate_policy: Use the episode's selected settings; record global rate separately from relative segment speed.

presenter.layout_switch: Aim for a complete hook ending at 10–20 seconds of approved narration; then switch from Avatar V large presenter to Avatar III circle.
presenter.connection_verification_scope: Not verified for the installing user; provide their authorized identity and connection.

opening.description: 白底桌前、手臂展开的大画面人物，开头完整钩子段使用

body.description: 正面半身圆形展示人物，正式讲解时剪辑放到左下角

presenter.avatar_selection_policy: Select avatar_roles.opening or avatar_roles.body by segment; no single-avatar fallback.
presenter.engine_policy: Opening uses Avatar 5; body lower-left uses Avatar 3. Explicit user requirement. Do not auto-switch engines.

approved_circle.framing: chest-up; face centered; no desk; head near upper circle edge
approved_circle.future_source_policy: Inspect new source and adapt crop; preserve confirmed chest-up framing. Existing slight head-top truncation was disclosed and accepted for the test; do not claim crop restores missing pixels. Check new source for complete head movement.

opening_segmentation.boundary: complete hook sentence; measured against approved narration, not guessed from text length
opening_segmentation.generation: split approved narration at the same boundary; opening audio only to Avatar V and remaining audio to Avatar III
opening_segmentation.exceptions: 10–20 seconds is a preference, not permission to cut words or silently rewrite approved narration; choose a nearby natural boundary and report a material overrun

postproduction.test_scope: Skill integration and local tooling only; no new episode render or paid generation.

distribution: Methods only. Avatar, voice and private project identities are not distributed.
